claims: McDonald's is launching new "KPop Demon Hunters" adult Happy Meals nationwide on March 31, 2026.
"KPop Demon Hunters" adult Happy Meals feature Netflix-themed partnerships.
"KPop Demon Hunters" adult Happy Meals feature collectibles.
"KPop Demon Hunters" adult Happy Meals feature specialty items like Ramyeon McShaker Fries.
KPop Demon Hunters Meals are available on March 31, 2026.
HUNTR/X Meal includes 10-piece Chicken McNuggets.
HUNTR/X Meal includes medium fries with Ramyeon seasoning (soy, garlic, sesame).
HUNTR/X Meal includes medium drink.
HUNTR/X Meal includes Hunter Sauce (sweet chili).
HUNTR/X Meal includes purple Demon Sauce (tangy mustard).
Saja Boys Breakfast Meal includes Spicy Saja McMuffin (with egg).
Saja Boys Breakfast Meal includes hash browns.
Saja Boys Breakfast Meal includes a small soda pop.
KPop Demon Hunters meals come in themed boxes with branded collectibles.
McDonaldland Meal was available in Aug 2025.
McDonaldland Meal included 10-piece McNuggets or Quarter Pounder with Cheese.
McDonaldland Meal included fries.
McDonaldland Meal included a mystery Mt. McDonaldland Shake.
McDonaldland Meal collectibles included tins containing postcards and stickers of characters like Grimace, Birdie, and the Hamburglar.
Previous adult meals ranged from approximately $15 to $17.
Adult Happy Meals are limited-time offerings available at participating McDonald's locations nationwide.
